name: Platform Link Parser
description: Turns a share link from a video or social platform into concrete download requests. Ships parsers for Weibo (best available MP4 + image sets), Xiaohongshu (watermark-free video + original images) and Pixiv (every page's urls.original). Registers one LinkParser plus one ProtocolClaim per platform; the engine knows nothing about these sites. Holds no credentials — where a platform needs a session it returns null and the host's own account handling takes over.
author: TurboDL
